NPU: 0.8 TOPS *GPU: ''Mali-G52 MP2'' @650MHz (OpenGL ES3.2, OpenCL 2.0) :VPU (with 4K VP9 and 4K 10-bit H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 32GB (eMMC) Flash, :TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4X) RAM *USB: 1x USB 3.0 (Type-A) port, :1x USB 3.0 (Type-C), 2x USB 2.0 ports *Network: 2x 1GbE, 2x 2.5GbE ports *Wi-Fi: [[MediaTek]] MT7921E (802.11ax) via M.2 (E-Key) *Power Source: 5-24V via barrel or 5V via USB (Type-C) ==Links of Interest== *[https://wiki.seeedstudio.com/Linkstar_Intro/ Docs] ===Reviews=== *[https://www.cnx-software.com/2022/11/19/linkstar-h68k-rockchip-rk3568-multimedia-router-with-dual-2-5gbe-dual-gigabit-ethernet/ ''LinkStar H68K - A Rockchip RK3568 “Multimedia” Router'' on '''CNX-Software'''] *[https://linuxgizmos.com/119-00-pocket-router-supports-wi-fi-6/ ''Pocket Router supports Wi-Fi 6'' on '''LinuxGizmos'''] ==Flashing== {{Flashnotice}} ===Flashing OpenWrt=== {{OpenWrt |techdata = https://openwrt.org/toh/hwdata/seeed/seeed_linkstar_h68k_1432_versions_one_and_two |wikipage = |forumpage = https://forum.openwrt.org/t/wip-support-for-linkstar-h68k-rk3568/233527 |github = |target = rockchip |subtarget = armv8 |arch = aarch64_generic |support_commit_id = f618048052f53e10367d7a65782990987b8454ab |support_started_version = unknown |current_supported_version = snapshot |last_supported_version = |image_too_big = |unsupportedfuncntions = audio, video |lan_hardware = |lan_comment = 2x Realtek RTL8125B 2.5Gbe Phy, 2x Realtek RTL8211F 1Gbe Phy |wlan_hardware = MediaTek M7921E (M.2 module) |wlan_comment = |usb_sata_comment = |inst_method = See forum |inst_comment = |rec_method = Serial |rec_comment = |comment = also known as HinLink, the OEM of the hardware to Seeed. }} {{SCollapse | git • >> | 
rockchip: add HINLINK H28K support
Hardware:
- RK3528 SoC
- 1x USB 2.0
- 8/32GB eMMC
- 1/2/4GB LPDDR4
- 1x 1GbE RTL8111H
- 1x 1GbE RTL8211F
- MicroSD card slot

Installation:
  Use dd or balenaEtcher to flash the firmware.

Note:
  The RK3528 SoC does not support MSI-X, so it can't
  adjust the interrupts of r8169 to other CPU cores.

Signed-off-by: Chukun Pan
(cherry picked from commit e8997e7e037742d03fa16650824e0daa9b0a2e3a)
